title: How to Grow Your Pilates Business - Marketing 360® Blog

facts.fact: The vendor advises expecting at least half of Pilates studio website traffic to come from phones.
facts.quote: Expect at least half your traffic to come from phones.

facts.fact: The vendor states that a Pilates studio can appear in three places on Google or Bing search results pages: paid ads, Google My Business, and organic listings.
facts.quote: There are three places you can show up on search results pages, and each has value in its own way.

facts.fact: The vendor says that with diligence, a business can show up in three places on page one of search results.
facts.quote: With diligence, you can show up in three places on page one.

facts.fact: The vendor describes the Google My Business listing as free to set up.
facts.quote: It’s a free listing you can optimize with your descriptions and by getting customer reviews.
